test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which number should be used in place of the question mark (?) if the series is to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56160b32a0580a439e8e16b1d75a99707ee5d46f38ea9e589c119640dc04ccf0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first column element and the bottom element element interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8869d1c4cec644ab99fcb2d9d12b77bbe15be38833aa340c4ba1f5b133c725b0.png] 

2) Second box series →

The 2nd row elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The 1st element of 3rd column is replaced by new element.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93e423f1bb7e4b6bf37da781e229e2cdf31660b893ed81035a5a5a4a36b8cede.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63844004e4cda5548a9f3b61b38476eb2958ace215f5dbefb5dc7252f76e1a9c.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
